title: Cosmo: detail prompts are a few words, not a 150-word paragraph
description: Cosmo wrote ~150-word prose for a masked detail op on a hand (Flux 3 tests project, 2026-10-21); it failed on Klein and Qwen 2.1. Fabio's 'hand over arm' on the same mask fixed it. Cause: the flux-3, qwen-image-2.1, krea-2 and flux-2 agent guides list detail with the long generation-prose ops; masking.md gives no length. Fix: detail = a few words naming what is in the crop, in masking.md and each guide.
